**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 18:30
- [FACT] User inquired about the economic impact of Indiana University (IU) on the Bloomington community.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IU had an economic impact of $5.6 billion in the Bloomington region according to a 2016 report by the IU Kelley School of Business.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IU contributed about 14% of the total economic output in Bloomington and generated over 39,000 jobs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IU employed over 10,000 people in Monroe County with a payroll of over $750 million according to a 2017 study by the Indiana Business Research Center.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IU received $600 million in research grants and contracts in 2015, generating about $1.3 billion in economic output across the state.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IU Bloomington students spent an estimated $127 million annually on housing, food, entertainment, and other expenses in 2016.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IU and its affiliated entities paid nearly $50 million in property taxes, sales taxes, and income taxes in Monroe County according to the 2016 Kelley School report.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Indiana University plays a critical role in the economic prosperity of the Bloomington community, creating jobs, driving innovation, and supporting local businesses.
- [USER] User requested a comparison of IU's economic impact to other universities in Indiana.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Purdue University had an economic impact of $7.5 billion across Indiana according to a 2017 report.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Purdue University supported about 67,000 employees through direct employment and job creation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] University of Notre Dame had an economic impact of about $2.46 billion in Northern Indiana in 2017.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ball State University had an economic impact of $1.33 billion in Indiana according to a 2016 study.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Indiana State University had an economic impact of $334 million in the Terre Haute region, supporting over 4,000 jobs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other universities in Indiana also play a critical role in the state's economy, each with unique strengths contributing to their economic impact.
- [USER] User expressed interest in how IU's economic impact compares to other universities in the Big Ten conference.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Indiana University ranks third in economic impact among Big Ten universities with an impact of $7.3 billion.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] University of Michigan had an economic impact of $11.9 billion.
